hardcoded-spacing.reason: Remaining values do not map exactly to the Carbon spacing scale and need layout or visual review before changing geometry.

hardcoded-typography.reason: Choosing a Carbon type token requires knowing the text role and hierarchy, not only its current numeric size.

hardcoded-theme-color.reason: Choosing semantic theme tokens requires light/dark visual review and editor, chart, brand, or status context.

scroll-owner-review.reason: Scroll ownership must be verified at runtime across container heights, zoom, and responsive viewports.
